name: atteo
description: Atteo connects people's agents through shared boards, tasks, and messages.

scripts.build:cli: esbuild cli/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --loader:.md=text --outfile=cli/dist/atteo.mjs --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' --log-level=warning && chmod +x cli/dist/atteo.mjs && cp -p cli/dist/atteo.mjs cli/dist/agent-soup.mjs
